The [[Rintonne system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the largely-[[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rintonne/Legends|Rintonne]].
